Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hello, i would like to know this:
vamp A (acting) is in combat with minion B.
Vamp A strikes with a superior Majesty, minion B strikes with a
Flamethrower,
can the Met controlling minion B plays a Rotshreck at this point?

Thanks in advance

Emiliano, Prince of Rome

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton wrote:
>
> Hello, i would like to know this:
> vamp A (acting) is in combat with minion B.
> Vamp A strikes with a superior Majesty, minion B strikes with a
> Flamethrower,
> can the Met controlling minion B plays a Rotshreck at this point?

Before combat ends (before strike resolution), yes, assuming it is
not Minion B's controller's turn.
